Vvan Film Makers Accused of Song Plagiarism

Independent artist Sargam Vaish has accused the makers of the film Vvan of using his song "Aigiri Nandini" in the movie's trailer without permission. Vaish alleges that his version of the song was "stolen" and used without his consent. He has stated that his legal team is involved and warned of legal action.
